description: Events API 2.0 track requests to business-api.tiktok.com /open_api/v1.3/event/track/. The Events 1.0 /pixel/track envelope is vendor/tiktok-events-api.

params.name: event_source
params.description: It names the channel. TikTok documents `web`, `app`, `offline`, and `crm`.
params.fix_hint: Set `event_source` to `web` for Pixel-measured website events.

params.name: event_source_id
params.description: It is the Pixel Code when `event_source` is `web`, or the matching event-set ID for app, offline, and CRM.
params.fix_hint: Set `event_source_id` to the Pixel Code from Events Manager for web events.

params.name: data
params.description: TikTok documents `data` as the array of events to report, at most 1,000.
params.fix_hint: Send one event object, or a batch, under `data`.

params.name: event
params.description: It is the conversion event name. TikTok documents it as required on every Events 2.0 event.
params.fix_hint: Set `event` to a documented standard name such as `Purchase` or `ViewContent`.

params.name: event_time
params.description: TikTok documents `event_time` as Unix time in seconds, UTC. A 13-digit value is milliseconds.
params.fix_hint: Send seconds since epoch, a 10-digit integer.

params.name: event_id
params.description: TikTok documents `event_id` as required when the same conversion is also sent from the browser Pixel.
params.fix_hint: Send the same `event_id` the Pixel fired.

params.name: page.url
params.description: TikTok documents `page.url` as required on web events.
params.fix_hint: Send the absolute page URL in `page.url`.

params.name: user.email
params.description: Email must be SHA-256 hashed after trim and lowercase.
params.fix_hint: Trim, lowercase, SHA-256, send the hex digest.

params.name: user.phone
params.description: Phone must be E.164 then SHA-256 hashed.
params.fix_hint: Normalize to E.164, hash with SHA-256, send the hex digest.

params.name: user.external_id
params.description: Advertiser-side identifiers must be SHA-256 hashed.

params.name: user.ttclid
params.description: It is the TikTok click id. TikTok documents it as a web match key.

params.name: user.ip
params.description: It is the visitor IP, sent unhashed.

params.name: user.user_agent
params.description: It is the visitor user agent, sent unhashed.

params.name: properties.currency
params.description: It is an ISO 4217 currency code. TikTok documents it as required for ROAS events.
params.fix_hint: Use the three-letter code, such as `USD`.

params.name: properties.value
params.description: It is the total order value. TikTok documents it as required for ROAS events.

rules.message: A field carries what looks like a raw email address. TikTok requires SHA-256 hashed email on Events API 2.0.
rules.fix_hint: Trim, lowercase, hash with SHA-256, and send the hex digest.

rules.message: This field looks like a SHA-256 digest, but TikTok documents `user.ip` and `user.user_agent` as unhashed.
rules.fix_hint: Send the raw IP address or user agent.

rules.message: The event has no match key. TikTok documents hashed email, phone, external_id, ttclid, or IP as the identifiers that attach the conversion to a person.
A revenue event is missing `properties.value` or `properties.currency`. TikTok documents both for ROAS events.
rules.fix_hint: Set `properties.value` to the order total and `properties.currency` to a three-letter ISO 4217 code.
